svg.content: <mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" type="device"><diagram id="16-ai-conversation" name="16 · AI conversation, memory and shared-Reel entities"><mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" page="0" pageWidth="2495.0" pageHeight="1355.0" shadow="0" adaptiveColors="none" scopeDescription="Implemented entities and conceptual associations; database enforcement is stated in the constraint note." schemaConstraints="UML entity model: solid lines are associations; multiplicities describe the named roles, not database integrity. Attributes use [0..1] for optional values and [0..*] for lists. {PK}/{UQ} are schema-key constraints. Enforced relations and scalar-ID mappings are listed below; cross-service IDs are not foreign keys. Solid Mongo associations are ORM relations, not SQL foreign-key constraints. ConversationMember is a parallel membership projection; participantIds remains a canonical contract. User IDs refer to User Service. No RagTrace entity exists in the current local AI schema; Langfuse holds monitoring snapshots. conversation: conversationId: Prisma Mongo association (declared Mongo ORM relation, not SQL FK); conversation: conversationId: Prisma Mongo association (declared Mongo ORM relation, not SQL FK); summary context: conversationId UNIQUE: logical one summary per conversation (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); source conversation: optional sourceConversationId (logical provenance) (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); share context: conversationId: cross-service share context (scalar-ID
